name: territory-kit
description: TypeScript-first geospatial territory engine for hierarchical polygon datasets.

scripts.data:tr:adm3:national:build: pnpm --filter @territory-kit/generators build && pnpm --filter @territory-kit/cli build && node packages/cli/dist/index.mjs tr adm3 build --official --osm --generated --fill-gaps --official-artifact .territory/build/TR/ADM3/official/levels/ADM3/dataset.json --output .territory/build/TR/ADM3 --force
scripts.geometry:validate:fixtures: pnpm --filter @territory-kit/dataset exec vitest run test/geometry-quality.test.ts --passWithNoTests && pnpm --filter @territory-kit/cli exec vitest run test/cli.test.ts --passWithNoTests
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "throw new Error('Root workspace must not be published. Publish packages from packages/* only.')"
scripts.registry:publish:smoke: pnpm --filter @territory-kit/registry exec vitest run test/publishing.test.ts --passWithNoTests && pnpm --filter @territory-kit/cli exec vitest run test/registry-publishing.test.ts --passWithNoTests
scripts.turkey:adm3:ingestion:smoke: pnpm --filter @territory-kit/generators build && pnpm --filter @territory-kit/generators exec vitest run test/turkey-adm3-ingestion.test.ts --passWithNoTests && pnpm --filter @territory-kit/cli exec vitest run test/turkey-adm3-ingestion.test.ts --passWithNoTests
scripts.turkey:adm3:production:smoke: pnpm --filter @territory-kit/generators exec vitest run test/turkey-adm3-full-coverage.test.ts test/turkey-adm3-osm.test.ts && pnpm --filter @territory-kit/cli build && node packages/cli/dist/index.mjs tr adm3 build --generated --fill-gaps --max-districts 2 --output .territory/build/TR/ADM3-smoke --force
scripts.turkey:v2:national:smoke: pnpm --filter @territory-kit/generators build && pnpm --filter @territory-kit/cli build && node packages/cli/dist/index.mjs tr v2 national plan && node packages/cli/dist/index.mjs tr v2 national build --max-districts 5 --output .territory/build/TR/V2-national-smoke --reports-output reports/tr-v2-national-smoke --force --no-render --no-mvt
scripts.turkey:v2:national:build: pnpm --filter @territory-kit/generators build && pnpm --filter @territory-kit/cli build && node packages/cli/dist/index.mjs tr v2 national build --output .territory/build/TR/V2-national --reports-output reports/tr-v2-national --force
scripts.turkey:v2:national:publish-ready: pnpm --filter @territory-kit/generators build && pnpm --filter @territory-kit/cli build && node packages/cli/dist/index.mjs tr v2 national publish-ready --dataset-version 2.0.0 --build-date 2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z --output .territory/build/TR/V2-national --reports-output reports/tr-v2-national --force
scripts.turkey:v2:national:validate: pnpm --filter @territory-kit/cli build && node packages/cli/dist/index.mjs tr v2 national validate --output .territory/build/TR/V2-national
scripts.turkey:v2:national:validate:publish-read: pnpm --filter @territory-kit/cli build && node packages/cli/dist/index.mjs tr v2 national validate --output .territory/build/TR/V2-national --publish-ready
scripts.turkey:v2:national:benchmark: pnpm --filter @territory-kit/generators build && pnpm --filter @territory-kit/cli build && node packages/cli/dist/index.mjs tr v2 national benchmark --output .territory/build/TR/V2-national-benchmark --reports-output reports/tr-v2-national --force
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm package:boundaries && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm bundle:size && pnpm data:tr:adm3:artifact-policy
